description: Anonymous pipe with a blocking reader (M6-D, Pipe syscall 83 + syscall-restart). userspace/ctests/musl_pipe.c: a reader thread blocks in read() on an empty pipe, main writes 'hello' and the reader wakes with it, then main closes the write end and the reader's next read returns EOF. Exercises the kernel pipe object and the hal syscall_restart_user_context path. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_pipe_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 45 --timeout 220 --boot-timeout 120

required.claim: a reader blocked on an empty pipe woke on write and its read re-executed to return the real bytes (syscall-restart)
closing the write end unblocks the reader with EOF
main joined the reader — no hang

forbidden.why: the blocking read did not return the written bytes
closing the write end did not yield EOF
